metadata.oracle: Python standard-library Decimal; separate xy-derived NPM and inverse stages
metadata.display_power: sign(v) * abs(v)^2.4; signed extension is an explicit oracle policy
metadata.target_policy: Clip each BT.709 linear component to [0,1], then power 1/2.4
metadata.c1_source_standard: ITU-R BT.2446-1 (03/2021) Tables 2/3; BT.2020-2 Table 4 inverse NCL
metadata.limitations: Component clipping is bounded but neither perceptual gamut mapping nor luminance preservation. Decimal rounding may leave order-1e-69 residuals at exact boundaries.
